info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List External Agency Correspondent Bank Directorys-spec
info.description: This API provides access to the comprehensive directory of correspondent banks associated with external agencies. It enables users to retrieve detailed information about various correspondent banks, facilitating efficient banking operations and collaborations. Typical consumers include financial institutions and regulatory bodies looking to enhance their banking connections or verify banking affiliations. By leveraging this API, organizations can improve their transaction processes and ensure compliance with financial regulations.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to access the directory of correspondent banks associated with the external agency. It provides detailed information about each bank, facilitating financial transactions and partnerships.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the correspondent bank directory. Ensure to provide the necessary parameters as defined in the schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the correspondent bank directory.
